title: Workflows and Business Processes
readerIntent: Understand durable processes containing manual and automatic actions.
owner: Application workflow family; nbpm supplies generic schema-lifecycle integration
summary: A durable carrier groups items while actions and channels move work through decisions, approvals, splits, retries, waiting, completion, and recovery.

sections.heading: Action model
items: A workflow is a collection of actions; each action may be manual or automatic according to its definition.
Manual actions wait for an authorized human decision.
Automatic actions call governed services, external APIs, AI providers, events, or other configured handlers.
One process may mix both types and branch or aggregate under explicit policy.

sections.heading: Not a pipeline or job
items: Pipeline: bounded technical execution without durable business state.
Scheduled job: timed trigger for approved work.
Workflow: durable business-visible state, actions, waiting, decisions, retries, compensation, and versioned recovery.
